facts: One landed production file changes by +3/-1: docstring limits zero-score fallback to successful episodes; _episode_score adds if-not-episode.ok ValueError with episode id after the existing dropped-trace guard.

Standard GEPAAdapter.evaluate waits for _run_batch, then computes the score list before constructing EvaluationBatch. A failed episode aborts this evaluation call instead of selectively removing a seat or returning a partial score/trajectory batch.

_run_batch awaits asyncio.gather of all env.run_slot calls. run_slot executes whole-episode retry and awaits on_complete before returning; runner on_complete persists with append_episode. The new check occurs after those attempts and callbacks.

make_reflective_dataset is unchanged and lacks its own failure guard. Normal evaluate cannot return this failed batch, but an externally constructed EvaluationBatch is not independently validated there.

Task.score records task reward hooks before invoking plugged judges. Rollout.close catches scoring/finalization Exception into fail and stamps trace.ok from _failed. Env.run_episode stamps episode.ok from all final traces only after hooks/finalize succeed; errors return with false default.

Successful trace/episode retry may retain older error history. Agent.run and run_episode_with_retry preserve that history independently of current ok; the new guard checks current episode.ok, not errors emptiness.

The existing dropped-trace error takes precedence. Successful zero rewards, reward-less successful episodes, and recovered-error episodes still use the unchanged mean. The selection tests truthy trace.rewards, whose None-only seeds can be truthy while Trace.reward sums to zero.

our_inference: GEPA score/trajectory admission must bind current episode verdict separately from trace rewards, drop status, retained retry history and persistence. This is a concrete native optimization boundary and a distinct acceptance obligation from previous dropped-only PR 2972. It narrows H3/H4 admission design without satisfying closed evaluation, durable replay, idempotence or model-quality gates.
